name: Vinnie 'The Pawn' Kowalski
flavor_text: A loudmouth from Brooklyn who learned chess last Tuesday. Hits hard but thinks harder... wait, no, he doesn't think at all.

name: Elena 'The Bishop' Petrov
flavor_text: Former chess prodigy turned amateur boxer. Reads your patterns like an open book. Good luck.

name: Magnus 'The Grandmaster' Thunderfist
flavor_text: The reigning champion. They say he solved a mate-in-7 while getting punched in the face. He didn't flinch.
